title: Appliance log tampering or suspicious shelling associated with UNC3886 - STRICT
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects appliance-side log tampering, persistence or shell spawning behavior associated with UNC3886-style post-exploitation. High-risk children (python3, nc, socat) spawned from service daemons fire without a CLI requirement. Shell and download tools require a suspicious CLI indicator.
